prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — quick question first so I give the best suggestions: what car do you have (make/model/year) or what tire size/brand are you looking for? Also do you have a Costco membership or need same‑day service?

Until then, general advice for buying and getting the best installation in Pleasanton, CA:

Where to buy
- Costco (if you’re a member): consistently low prices, very good mounting/balancing service and useful perks (lifetime rotations, flat repairs in many locations). Good value if you don’t mind booking ahead.
- Discount Tire / America’s Tire (nearest location outside Pleasanton): wide selection, competitive pricing, strong reputation for service and quick same‑day installs.
- National chains with good coverage: Firestone Complete Auto Care, NTB, Pep Boys — convenient, come with national warranties and frequent coupons.
- Local independent shops: often match or beat chain prices and give more personalized service. Look for shops with many positive local reviews.

Who does the best installation
- “Best” = technician skill + equipment + quality control. Look for:
  - ASE‑certified technicians
  - modern mounting machines and computerized balancers (ask if they offer road‑force balancing for high‑performance tires)
  - torqueing lug nuts to manufacturer spec with a torque wrench
  - TPMS reprogramming/verification included
  - new valve stems included and proper nitrogen or air fill to spec
  - alignment service available (recommended after new tires if suspension/steering feel off)
- Independent well‑reviewed shops and Discount Tire/Costco/Firestone are all good choices if they meet the items above. For very high‑end or run‑flat tires, consider a specialty shop that offers road‑force balancing.

How to choose among nearby shops
- Check Google and Yelp for recent local reviews specifically mentioning installation quality and post‑install issues.
- Ask the shop: do your techs have ASE certs? Do you use a torque wrench? Do you offer road‑force balancing and alignment? Is TPMS service included?
- Compare total price including mounting, balancing, disposal fee, new valve stems and any road hazard warranty.

If you want, I can:
- Look up and list specific Pleasanton-area shops (addresses, phone numbers, and top‑rated installers) — tell me you want that and whether you’re okay with me using your location or just “Pleasanton, CA.”
- Compare prices for a specific tire size/brand if you tell me your tire size or car model.
